features.name: One-tap recording
features.description: A floating microphone button on the home list starts a new recording in one tap. If a calendar event is in progress, a bottom sheet asks whether to record that event or a new untitled recording. Input from the built-in mic or a Bluetooth headset (AirPods).
features.reason: The heart of the app. AVAudioRecorder or AVAudioEngine records on the device with no network; the calendar choice is optional and can be dropped.

features.name: Live transcript while recording
features.description: While recording, the transcript appears paragraph by paragraph with a timestamp per paragraph. A bottom bar shows a red recording dot, a level waveform, the elapsed time, pause and stop.
features.reason: On-device speech recognition (SFSpeechRecognizer with requiresOnDeviceRecognition on iOS 17, SpeechTranscriber on iOS 26) gives live text without a server. Otter does it in the cloud and only when online.

features.name: Background and locked-screen recording
features.description: Recording continues with the screen off or with another app in front, and can be stopped later from the app.
features.reason: UIBackgroundModes audio with an active AVAudioSession keeps recording. Reviews complain about recordings that stop halfway: reliability is a differentiator.

features.name: Pause and resume
features.description: Pause button in the recording bar; the recording continues in the same note after resume.
features.reason: Trivial with AVAudioRecorder.pause/record; no network.

features.name: Highlight a moment while recording
features.description: A highlight button in the recording bar marks the sentence just spoken. Highlights are collected in a panel of the note and shown inline in the transcript.
features.reason: A timestamp stored with the note; fully local.

features.name: Insert photo during recording
features.description: A camera/photo button adds a picture of a whiteboard or slide, which is placed in the transcript at the moment it was taken.
features.reason: PhotosPicker or the camera with a timestamp; local. Secondary to the one function of transcribing.

features.name: Speaker labels
features.description: Paragraphs grouped by speaker with name and avatar. The user tags speakers and Otter learns to recognise their voice in later meetings.
features.reason: Apple offers no on-device diarisation API on iOS 17 or 26. Manual speaker tagging per paragraph is possible locally; automatic voice recognition is not without a third-party model.

features.name: Automatic punctuation and paragraphs
features.description: The transcript is punctuated, capitalised and split into paragraphs at pauses and speaker changes.
features.reason: addsPunctuation on SFSpeechRecognitionRequest (iOS 16+) and segment timestamps for paragraph breaks; on-device.

features.name: Playback synced to the text
features.description: An audio player under the note. The current word is highlighted while playing; tapping any word jumps the audio there. Playback speed is selectable.
features.reason: AVAudioPlayer with the segment timestamps from the recogniser; local. Otter limits speeds to Pro.

features.name: Skip silence
features.description: During playback, silent stretches are skipped.
features.reason: Can be computed locally from audio levels or the gaps between transcript segments. Paid in Otter.

features.name: Search across notes and inside a transcript
features.description: A search icon on the home searches all notes; inside a note, search highlights each match and shows the count.
features.reason: Local text search on stored transcripts (SwiftData predicate or in-memory filter).

features.name: Edit the transcript
features.description: Tap a paragraph to correct words, confirm with a checkmark. Title editable.
features.reason: Local text editing. Reviews complain that correcting is hard and that the whole transcript cannot be copied at once.

features.name: Custom vocabulary
features.description: A settings list of names and terms the recogniser often gets wrong, to improve accuracy.
features.reason: contextualStrings on SFSpeechRecognitionRequest (and contextual strings in SpeechAnalyzer) work on-device.

features.name: Import audio and video files
features.description: A cloud-upload icon on the home imports an audio or video file and transcribes it like a recording.
features.reason: fileImporter plus SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest or SpeechAnalyzer on a file; on-device. Otter limits free imports to 3 in a lifetime.

features.name: Export
features.description: Export audio (mp3) and text (txt), and on paid plans pdf, docx and srt subtitles; bulk export on Business.
features.reason: ShareLink with plain text, SRT built from timestamps, audio file and PDF via ImageRenderer/UIGraphicsPDFRenderer; all local. Reviews complain that data is held hostage behind the paywall.

features.name: AI summary, outline, keywords and action items
features.description: After the meeting a Summary tab shows a short paragraph, a checklist of action items with assignees, and an outline of topics with bullet points.
features.reason: Otter does it on its servers. On the device only Foundation Models (iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence, 4096-token context) can do it: needs a decision on availability and long transcripts.

features.name: AI chat on a meeting and across all meetings
features.description: A chat tab inside each note and a global chat tab where the user asks questions, drafts follow-up emails and gets answers with links to the source meetings.
features.reason: Cloud LLM with an account. A local equivalent would need Foundation Models and is outside the one function of transcribing.

features.name: OtterPilot: bot that joins Zoom, Meet and Teams
features.description: From synced calendars, a bot joins online meetings automatically, records, captures slides and writes the summary.
features.reason: Requires an account, server-side bot and calendar/network integration.

features.name: Calendar sync and agenda
features.description: An Upcoming carousel with today's meetings, a switch for automatic summary per meeting, auto-title of notes from the event, reminders to record.
features.reason: Built around the online-meeting bot and the account; EventKit naming could be a later nicety but is not needed for the function.

features.name: Sharing, collaboration, comments and channels
features.description: Invite people to view and edit a note, comment, assign action items, share external links, AI Channels for team chat.
features.reason: Requires accounts and a server.

features.name: Folders
features.description: Create folders and move notes into them from a multi-select menu.
features.reason: Local grouping; useful only with many notes.

features.name: Siri Shortcut and Home Screen widget
features.description: Start and stop recording from a Shortcut or a home widget.
features.reason: App Intents (with openAppWhenRun or AudioRecordingIntent on iOS 18) and WidgetKit; local.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Transcription in English, Spanish, French and Japanese only (no Italian).
features.reason: The most frequent complaint in Italian reviews. Apple on-device recognition supports Italian and many other locales.

flows.name: Record an in-person conversation
steps: Tap the microphone button on the home
Choose the current event or a new recording
Watch the transcript appear live; highlight or add a photo if needed
The note opens with transcript; summary and outline arrive after processing

flows.name: Review a past note
steps: Open a note from the home list
Read the Summary or switch to Transcript
Play the audio, tap a word to jump, change speed
Search a word, edit a paragraph, tag a speaker
Export or share from the more menu

flows.name: Import a file
steps: Tap the upload icon on the home
Pick an audio or video file
Wait for transcription; the new note appears in the list

fields.name: title
fields.note: auto from calendar event or date, editable

data_model.storage: Otter stores everything in its cloud behind an account. For Sbu: SwiftData on the device for notes and segments, audio files in Application Support, no sync.

monetization.model: Freemium subscription with an account. Free Basic plan with monthly minute caps; Pro, Business and Enterprise subscriptions.
monetization.price: Basic free (300 min/month, 30 min per conversation, 3 imports in a lifetime). Pro 16.99 USD/month or 8.33 USD/month yearly (1,200 min, 90 min per conversation). Business 30 USD/month or 19.99 USD/month yearly.
paywalled_features: access to older notes after the subscription ends
monetization.notes: Listing mentions Otter Pro for more speeds, skip silence and bulk export; plan limits from otter.ai/pricing.

user_pains.pain: Italian not supported: Italian speech is transcribed as invented English
user_pains.evidence: Italian reviews: 'non trascrive in lingua italiana', 'Non gestisce lingua italiana', 'Only works with English', 'Only detects English', subscription bought before finding out

user_pains.pain: Almost everything is behind the subscription and the free trial is too short
user_pains.evidence: US reviews: 'U have to pay for everything', 'transcription limit on free sub, so can't test', 'It is NOT FREE', broke student wishing it were free
'Sometimes it stops recording in the middle', 'Did not record the entire meeting', 'Lost meeting minutes', summary still missing after 10 hours

user_pains.pain: Data held hostage after the subscription ends
user_pains.evidence: 'Holds your data hostage... can't get it unless I pay, not even the raw recording'

user_pains.pain: Cannot copy the whole transcript, editing is hard
user_pains.evidence: 'Only lets you copy each speaking point at a time', 'correcting is difficult', no way to edit at length
'There's no calendar view to go back and find old meetings... scrolling along a list'
'Do you want an entire UI to have to interact with and learn', 'over developed and not well thought out'

user_pains.pain: Unexpected renewals and privacy fears about recording
user_pains.evidence: 'auto-recurring charges... got charged for 1.5 years', 'recording my activities... without my knowledge'
